groups.defect: Metric recorder calls are wrong: the Create and Update storage-error paths call recordLegacyDuration, the DeleteCollection legacy goroutine calls recordStorageDuration, and Delete's success path passes the object name as the kind label.
groups.rationale: s_1f0c2877 and s_f5076626 each report all four metric mis-recordings. The other suggestions each report one of them, so the overlap links them all into one group.

groups.defect: The async legacy-write goroutines derive their context from the request context, which is canceled when the handler returns, so legacy writes silently abort.
groups.rationale: All four report the same request-context cancellation problem across the four goroutines and propose the same fix, context.WithoutCancel.

groups.defect: No mode-3 test, unit or integration, checks that the async legacy write actually happens, so removing it would leave every test green.
groups.rationale: All three report the same test gap, the unasserted legacy write. s_952eaebd explicitly covers both the unit and the integration tests, and s_c52e7744 points at the integration subtests.

groups.defect: Update passes the raw objInfo to Legacy.Update instead of an updateWrapper around the storage result, so legacy recomputes the update and can diverge from storage.
groups.rationale: All three report the dropped updateWrapper in the Update goroutine and propose restoring it.

groups.defect: Delete returns early on a storage NotFound and never deletes the legacy copy, leaving objects that exist only in legacy orphaned.
groups.rationale: Both report the same lost NotFound fall-through in Delete and propose the same fix.
